content.tex: Section A
INVESTIGATION REGULAR POLYGONS
You are advised to spend no longer than 45 minutes on this section.
In this task you will investigate fitting 3 regular polygons together at a point.
All the polygons have sides of the same length. The 3 polygons fit together exactly with one corner from each polygon meeting at a point with no gaps or overlaps.
